method: IVs backed out from settled/last prices: forward by put-call parity at the strike nearest spot, out-of-the-money side, Black-Scholes with r = 0, time = calendar days to the 15:30 expiry close / 365. Front expiry = nearest with at least 2 calendar days left.

gex.assumption: Writers are taken to hold the mirror of the NSE 'Client' bucket's net index-option position on 2026-11-27: clients net long 213,039 call contracts and net short 624,993 put contracts, so writers are net short 3.4% of call OI and net long 13.2% of put OI, spread evenly across strikes. Participant data covers all index options, not NIFTY alone, and one session behind the chain at worst.
gex.unit: Rs crore of delta per 1% NIFTY move
gex.read: Net writer gamma changes sign at 26,142 (above spot by 535 points). At spot, writers are LONG gamma: their hedging sells rallies and buys dips, which dampens moves and pins price toward the heavy strikes. For a seller: the tape favours short premium near the pin strike while spot stays on this side of the flip.

cone.read: ATM implied vol of the expiry nearest 5 sessions (08-Dec-2026, about 7 sessions) is 14.85%: the 60th percentile of every 5-session realised vol since 2007, against 23.71% realised over the last 5 sessions: premium is fair to rich.
